text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"bought 20 marbles from Johanna"},{"id":"q2","value":50,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"a store that had 50"},{"id":"q3","value":0.4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2/5 times as many marbles as he bought from Johanna"},{"id":"q4","value":2,"unit":"kg","kind":"count","span":"each marble weighs 2kgs"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"marbles his father gave him, 2/5 of the 20 bought"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s2","note":"store's marbles after adding the 20 bought"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s1"],"out":"s3","note":"total marbles after adding father's marbles too"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","q4"],"out":"s4","note":"total weight of all the marbles"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the total weight of marbles Solomon has in the store"},"dismissed":[]}
